what: Inside a three-screen-tall section, the video (photo) pinned to the screen grows linearly from .8 to 1 (scroll-linked, no curve) during one screen of scroll, starting when the section top touches the top of the screen. Once full, a translucent accent color → contrast stage curtain lays down over .6s, and .6s after that the text panel rises 2.5rem over .6s. Scrolling back up below 1 reverses it

options.from: Starting scale, default .8 — also match css --fx-from (the first screen before script)
options.lag: Seconds the element lags behind scroll (scrub value), default 0 (immediate — original anime.js onScroll sync)
options.--fx-length: (css variable) section length, default 300svh — the veil and text stay on screen for the remaining length
options.--fx-dur · --fx-rise: (css variable) length of the veil and text rising (default .6s) · text distance (default 2.5rem)
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: (If any) Overlay laid down once filled — stuck to the screen
options.[data-fx-part=body]: (If any) text panel that rises late inside the scrim

use: …

from.where: index.html .movie concept video (original SectionMovie — anime.js animate scale .8→1 linear, onScroll enter top top · leave top-=100svh top · sync, when progress ≥ 1 it becomes is-video-full: curtain opacity .6s · text translateY 2.5rem .6s .6s)
